en.text: Hear my prayer, LORD. Listen to my petitions. In your faithfulness and righteousness, relieve me.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你听我的祷告，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你聽我的禱告，

en.text: Don’t enter into judgment with your servant, for in your sight no man living is righteous.
For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those who have been long dead.
Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.

zhSimplified.text: 所以，我的灵在我里面发昏；

zhTraditional.text: 所以，我的靈在我裏面發昏；

en.text: I remember the days of old. I meditate on all your doings. I contemplate the work of your hands.
I spread out my hands to you. My soul thirsts for you, like a parched land. Selah.

zhSimplified.text: 我向你举手； 你， 一样。

zhTraditional.text: 我向你舉手； 你， 一樣。

en.text: Hurry to answer me, LORD. My spirit fails. hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go down into the pit.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你速速应允我！

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你速速應允我！

en.text: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.

zhSimplified.text: 求你使我清晨得听你慈爱，

zhTraditional.text: 求你使我清晨得聽你慈愛，

en.text: Deliver me, LORD, from my enemies. I flee to you to hide me.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你救我脱离我的仇敌！

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你救我脫離我的仇敵！

en.text: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.

zhSimplified.text: 求你指教我遵行你的旨意，

zhTraditional.text: 求你指教我遵行你的旨意，

en.text: Revive me, LORD, for your name’s sake. In your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你为你的名将我救活，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你為你的名將我救活，

en.text: In your loving kindness, cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul, for I am your servant.

zhSimplified.text: 凭你的慈爱剪除我的仇敌，

zhTraditional.text: 憑你的慈愛剪除我的仇敵，
